notation.term: Finite values and the actual domain
notation.meaning: SourceProper f excludes minus infinity and supplies a finite witness; U=int{x:f(x)<plus infinity}. SourceLipschitzOn requires actual finite real values at every point in V before its absolute-difference inequality.

notation.term: All global supports, only interior queries
notation.meaning: g∈∂f(x) tests f(x)+inner(g,y-x)≤f(y) at every ambient y. The norm conclusion ranges over every such g at every x∈U; it does not extend to boundary queries.

L∈NNReal means L≥0, with L=0 allowed. This makes the source proof’s ordinary nonnegative Lipschitz convention explicit. An unrestricted negative-L reading fails for the admitted zero-dimensional extension; the compiled proper convex constant-zero fixture records this delta.

algorithm.title: Prove both implications on the actual domain interior

steps.title: Restrict the actual pair bound to a ball
steps.detail: Every interior query has a positive-radius ambient ball in U. The pair bound and finite values hold on that actual ball, so the existing normalized-support perturbation proves the bound for every g.

steps.title: Construct supports at both pair points
steps.detail: Proper convexity and interior membership give actual global supports gx,gy via the accepted interior-existence theorem, not an extra support-existence assumption.

steps.title: Use finite conversion and both signs
steps.detail: Convert their supporting inequalities at finite x,y to real inequalities. Cauchy-Schwarz and the uniform norm bound control f(x)-f(y) and f(y)-f(x), giving the full absolute difference.

source_theorems.label: Definition2.29 finite all-pairs Lipschitz property
source_theorems.math: V\subseteq\operatorname{dom} f,\quad |f(x)-f(y)|\le L\|x-y\|\quad\forall x,y\in V,\quad L\ge0
source_theorems.fallback: Actual finite values on V plus the all-pairs bound, with an explicitly nonnegative Lipschitz constant.
source_theorems.plain: A Lipschitz property concerns actual finite values on its stated set. Real projections of infinite values do not satisfy the required finite-value witness.
source_theorems.relationship: The source codomain excludes minus infinity. The shared EReal definition explicitly requires finite witnesses on V; under properness this matches V subsetdom f. NNReal makes the ordinary nonnegative constant convention explicit, rather than claiming arbitrary realL.

source_theorems.label: Theorem2.30 full interior Lipschitz/subgradient equivalence
source_theorems.math: f\ \text{proper convex},\ L\ge0,\ U=\operatorname{int}\operatorname{dom}f:\quad \bigl[|f(x)-f(y)|\le L\|x-y\|\ \forall x,y\in U\bigr]\Longleftrightarrow\bigl[\|g\|\le L\ \forall x\in U,\ g\in\partial f(x)\bigr]
source_theorems.fallback: For proper convex f and nonnegative L, finite all-pairs Lipschitz on domain interior iff every global support at every interior query has norm at most L.
source_theorems.plain: The actual full equivalence includes both directions and every support. Proper convexity supplies the supports needed for the reverse proof.
source_theorems.relationship: Coordinate-free finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces represent Rd/L2. Nonnegative NNReal (zero allowed) is an explicit source-convention delta: the printed theorem does not write L>=0, while its zero-support proof case uses it. The compiled negative-L dimension0 audit refutes unrestricted realL for the admitted extension; this is not an assertion of a contradiction if dimension is separately assumed positive. Empty interior and dimension0 are retained; no boundary, closedness or differentiability extension.

contract.parameters: Every interior point, every ordered interior pair and every actual global support; one fixed L.
contract.regret: No online algorithm or regret guarantee claimed.
contract.guarantee: Full iff on U, with actual finite values, no whole-domain/boundary or unrestricted negativeL claim.

proof_bridge.title: Actual supports and two signs establish the full iff
proof_bridge.summary: Forward uses an actual open ball; reverse actually obtains both global supports.

steps.title: Finite values prevent an infinity projection shortcut
steps.detail: At an interior point properness excludes bottom and domain membership excludes top, yielding f(x)=coe(toReal f(x)). SourceLipschitzOn separately requires actual finite witnesses on its set.
steps.fallback: No arbitrary representative at an infinite value.

steps.title: Perturb along every given support
steps.detail: Choose a positive radius with ball(x,r) subsetU. The earlier norm-ball theorem uses z=x+t g with t=r/(2||g||) for g≠0; source support and Lipschitz give t||g||²≤L t||g||. The zero support case uses L≥0.
steps.fallback: The actual perturbation proof is reused, not an assumed stability consumer.

steps.title: Derive actual source supports at x and y
steps.detail: The existing proper-convex interior theorem constructs gx∈∂f(x) and gy∈∂f(y). No subgradient-existence hypothesis is added. Both support inequalities are ambient global.
steps.math: f(x)+\langle g_x,y-x\rangle\le f(y),\quad f(y)+\langle g_y,x-y\rangle\le f(x)
steps.fallback: The producer supplies both supports from the source assumptions.

steps.title: Bound both real differences
steps.detail: Finite EReal conversion gives ordinary real inequalities. Negative inner products are bounded by their absolute value, Cauchy-Schwarz and L times the actual displacement norm. The two signs give the absolute bound for every pair.
steps.fallback: Full converse with the same L, without a selected-gradient shortcut.
